rows.text: The statement, headed 'THE APPOINTMENT OF THE HON. TU'IVAKANO AS SPEAKER OF THE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY OF TONGA', says that the Hon. Tu'ivakano 'embraced his appointment last week as Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Tonga (Parliament) from 2002 to 2004', following election to his third successive term in the House, and that he 'succeeds the Hon. Veikune'.
rows.uncertainty: No day and no appointing authority are stated, and 'last week' may attach to the appointment or to his acceptance of it. The statement's date is derived from its file name and metadata (scope note); the capture of 3 June 2002 is the latest possible date. '2002 to 2004' is the term as printed, not a boundary, and 'succeeds the Hon. Veikune' names the predecessor without an end date. The Assembly later gave 1 July 2002 for the appointment (to_la_ministers_page_tuivakano_appointed_20020701, to_la_profile_tuivakano_appointed_20020701); the conflict is retained and neither date is a holder date.
